suggested_session.type: official prompt, practice with AI coach
suggested_session.coach_timing_estimate: 2 minutes instruction, 1 minute Part 2 preparation if applicable, 2–4 minutes answer, 8 minutes feedback, 5 minutes redo one aspect
suggested_session.score_policy: AI estimate with evidence/uncertainty for adequate audio sample; transcript-only cannot assess pronunciation or reliable fluency timing. Not an official examiner result.
